summary: BIOXIC round 2 — new features (live chat realtime, share menu WhatsApp/TikTok/copy, winter theme restore, floating mini-player, banner with artist.jpg + logo.png). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (previous 9 + 6 new in test_chat_share.py covering /api/share/{slug|id|unknown} + WS /api/ws/chat history/broadcast/heart-tap/like_count/empty-message-drop). Frontend verified at 1366 viewport on preview URL. Theme: body background rgb(6,17,13) dark pine, gold accents on CTAs/avatar ring/send button, berry red for LIVE/live-dot — no cyan residues observed. Snowfall canvas rendering. Channel header: /artist.jpg banner with /logo.png centered + rounded avatar with gold ring + 'Abonează-te' gold pill + tab underline gold. CHAT: 2 parallel sessions tested — name gate -> text input, A->B and B->A messages delivered realtime (<2s), chat-viewers increased to 2, chat-heart-button increments like counter visible on other session. SHARE: live-share and track-share-* open menus with WhatsApp (wa.me href OK), TikTok (copy+toast), Copy link. /api/share/{slug|id} returns HTML with og:image for valid tracks and 404 for unknown. MINI-PLAYER: player-bar floats bottom-centered (not stuck to edge), gold play/pause, LIVE badge with listener count, share icon, works on mobile viewport. Admin login admin@bioxic.ro / bioxic2024 works; upload-only panel + skip + track list render. No 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors across pages. Title 'Ce bunaciune (Remake AI Cover)' preserved (allowed per spec).
action_items: None required. Optional cosmetic: /api/auth/me returns 401 on unauth admin page load, logged by axios to console as 'Failed to load resource 401'. Non-blocking (same as iteration 1 comment).
critical_code_review_comments: LiveChat.jsx uses WS reconnect with 3s retry — good. Message/history dedupe is non-existent — on reconnect the user may see duplicate 'join' messages. Low priority.
ShareButton.jsx TikTok fallback relies on clipboard.writeText which can silently fail in some embedded contexts; UI only shows success toast on resolve and swallows catch. OK for MVP.
server.py still 1450+ lines — iteration 1 recommendation to split into routers still open.
Chat message rate is not rate-limited server-side; a client could spam. Consider throttling per connection.
seed_data_creation: Added a handful of 'TEST_UserA/TEST_UserB' chat messages via live test — benign. Can be cleaned by admin DELETE /api/admin/chat/{id} if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression now covers chat WS + share OG endpoints (test_chat_share.py). pytest.ini has asyncio_mode=auto so any @pytest.mark.asyncio or auto-detected async test will run under -n 2 loadscope. Preview URL loads clean; theme vars are var(--night) #06110d / var(--accent) gold / var(--berry) red. Chat testids: chat-container, chat-name-input, chat-name-save, chat-text-input, chat-send-button, chat-heart-button, chat-messages, chat-viewers, chat-likes. Share testids: live-share{,-menu,-whatsapp,-tiktok,-copy}, track-share-{id}{,-menu,-whatsapp,-tiktok,-copy}.
